Medical History

- Current health issues and chronic disease risk factors (e.g., hypertension, diabetes):

Intermittent swelling after initial runs (resolved with ice). No locking, no functional limitation with normal walking or stairs. Possible overuse/mechanical injury. Prior sport-related fall on ice months ago with large bruise.
  - Intermittent tingling in right toes once after a run.
  - Intermittent dependent leg/foot swelling noted (socks leaving indentations after standing).
  - No documented chronic diseases (hypertension, diabetes, CVD) in transcript.
